newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank expects peso market to calm soon.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank expects peso market to calm soon.

text.p: The Philippines central bank said on Tuesday it expected the foreign exchange market to stabilise soon but added that while it would allow the peso to float more freely it wanted orderly market conditions.
"We expect the foreign exchange market to calm down and stabilise in the next couple of days," Governor Gabriel Singson said in a statement.
"We are sending strong monetary signals to let the market realise that while the peso will be allowed to float more flexibly, we also want to see orderly market conditions," Singson said.
"We will continue with a firm monetary policy stance to support our decison last Friday, July 11 to alow the peso to float more freely," he said noting interest rates had been kept high.
The peso has plunged about 14 percent since last Friday's decision move to allow the peso to move in a wider band.
